612.name: Shadow Stab
612.skilldes: Quickly hides in dark shadows, becoming untargetable by skills and immune to status effects. Performs multiple high-speed stabs in the shadows, dealing 5 hits of <color=#ed9053>270%</color> Neutral Melee P.DMG. The slash marks left by the rapid stabs explode after a short delay, dealing <color=#ed9053>450%</color> Neutral Melee P.DMG. After casting, gains P.DMG Bonus +<color=#ed9053>20%</color> for 5 sec
